name: She association death mutual aid (社邑喪葬互助), Dunhuang
key_source: Ning Ke and Hao Chunwen, Dunhuang sheyi wenshu jijiao (1997), Zotero HTDVN55W, read on the page images (the OCR copy UE9ZV5MT locates only). SCOPE: the members' obligations to one another at a death, coded from the death clauses of the ten practical bylaws (nos. 1-9, 12; no. 9 has no death clause), the 20 in-scope death circulars (nos. 21, 24, 27, 28, 30-36, 38, 39, 42-48), the 27 in-scope contribution registers (nos. 214-241 less 223), the petitions to join and leave (nos. 325-331) and the enforcement documents (151, 156, 253); models, drafts and copies are variants, never cases. The unit is the practice across Dunhuang's associations; where they differ the cell takes the modal state and the note gives counts. EXCLUDED: the Turfan bylaws of 658 (comparison only); the irrigation associations (渠社, 渠人), a boundary; the officially levied register S. 3978 (no. 223), noted at MB3; the 義聚 loan stock (loan registers nos. 244-252), lending to members being credit, not the pooling of losses, and no document showing it pay a funeral (CN1). NON-INDEPENDENCE: the cells count documents, not associations. Not independent: circulars 43 and 44 (one 兄弟社, 988); circular 27 and register 219 (one association, 944 and 949); copies 40 and 41; registers 229 and 253 (possibly one). Ning and Hao is the only witness to the texts; Teiser 2020 and Hao 2021 were not read for coding, so no cell rests on a second witness. CO-OCCURRENCE, assessed and negative (the column cannot say so; .NR): huiguan, resemblance only, never descent, any likeness parallelism until descent is argued; the guild death-benefit rows, functional comparison only. A future organizational_forms she row would be same-institution. Coded 2026-10-13/14, open, claude-opus-5-5, effort high; priors committed before reading (records/PRIORS-she-associations-2026-10-13.md); rulings 1-12 in records/RULINGS-she-associations-2026-10-13.md.
